customManagers.description: The dotnet-ef tool the image uses to build the migrations bundle (Headhunter.API/Dockerfile). semver versioning, because NuGet versioning reads a bare 10.0.0 as the range >= 10.0.0 and never offers an update. As GrifballWebApp's renovate.json

The .NET images (Dockerfile FROM ...:10.0-alpine), looked up in .NET's own release list rather than the image tags: the tags exist from the first preview, the list has a stable 11.0.x only once 11.0 ships (previews like 11.0.0-rc.2 don't match extractVersion). The docker manager's own lookup of these images is off (packageRules). As GrifballWebApp's renovate.json
The projects' TargetFramework (net10.0), moved with the images in the .NET major PR

packageRules.description: Everything goes into one PR, majors included
Packages tied to the .NET version: keep minors in the big PR but split majors out

Everything tied to the Angular version gets its own PR, never the big one: Angular itself, TypeScript, and Node (the client build image and the CI setup-node version, which Renovate looks up as actions/node-versions). Minors and patches go to an Angular PR (renovate/angular), majors to Angular major (renovate/major-angular, below). As GrifballWebApp's renovate.json
Angular majors get their own PR; they need ng update migrations and careful testing. zone.js versions and the node build image are tied to the Angular version, so they ride along
prBodyNotes: **Angular major:** don't merge this as is. Check out this branch and run `npx ng update @angular/core@{{{newMajor}}} @angular/cli@{{{newMajor}}}` in `Headhunter.Client` (Angular's migrations; it also moves TypeScript), commit the result, then run the client tests and try the app. See https://angular.dev/update-guide.

packageRules.description: zone.js is 0.x and each minor pairs with an Angular major; the slug makes its minor land in the same renovate/major-angular branch as the Angular majors
Node (the client build image and the CI setup-node version, which Renovate looks up as actions/node-versions) must be a version the Angular CLI supports
Angular only supports one TypeScript minor at a time and ng update bumps it during Angular majors, so Renovate only does TypeScript patches

.NET majors get their own PR, the projects' TargetFramework (net10.0) with them (customManagers). The Serilog hosting/configuration bridges are versioned with .NET; dotnet-ef must match EF Core; dotnet-sdk is global.json's SDK
The .NET images are looked up by the regex manager above (.NET's release list), not by their tags, which offer a .NET major from its first preview

CsvHelper 34 is a complete rewrite (its API moved: CsvHelper.Configuration, TypeConversion, ClassMap), so a CsvHelper major needs Headhunter.CSVDump ported by hand. It stays out of the big PR and waits on the Dependency Dashboard until someone ticks it
